DailySlot.description:
Today's daily lesson. `waiting` means the morning hour has not arrived yet;
`not_scheduled` means the morning lesson is off and none was requested.
DailySlot.title: DailySlot

Direction.description: A suggested follow-up the reader can choose under "Go deeper".
Direction.title: Direction

ErrorBody.description: Every 4xx/5xx application error has this shape.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

ExportDocument.description: Everything durable, for analysis and backup. `schema_version` is the database's.
ExportDocument.title: ExportDocument

FirebaseWebConfig.description: Public Firebase web app configuration; not a secret.
FirebaseWebConfig.title: FirebaseWebConfig

FollowUpRequest.description: Exactly one of a suggested direction (by index into `go_deeper`) or a question.
FollowUpRequest.title: FollowUpRequest

FurtherItem.description: A book, film, work, or place to explore; the frontend builds search links.
FurtherItem.title: FurtherItem

GlossaryEntry.description: A term worth keeping and a short definition.
GlossaryEntry.title: GlossaryEntry

HealthStatus.description: Public health status without connection details or credentials.
HealthStatus.title: HealthStatus

Illustration.description: A resolved image: URL on upload.wikimedia.org and the article it came from.
Illustration.title: Illustration

next_attempt_at.description: When a queued job will next be tried, e.g. after a usage limit.
next_attempt_at.title: Next Attempt At

request_text.description: The owner's topic or question, if any.
request_text.title: Request Text

thread.description: Every lesson in this thread, oldest first, including this one.
thread.title: Thread

time_zone_confirmed.description: False until the owner or the browser has set the time zone.
time_zone_confirmed.title: Time Zone Confirmed

PreferencesUpdate.description: Fields left out stay unchanged. The time zone must be an IANA name.
PreferencesUpdate.title: PreferencesUpdate

current_streak.description: Consecutive days with a finished lesson, ending today or yesterday.
current_streak.title: Current Streak

days.description: The last 84 local days, oldest first.
days.title: Days

ReadingReport.description:
Cumulative totals for one reader visit, sent every 30 s while visible and on hide.

The server keeps the largest values seen per session, so repeats and late
arrivals are harmless.
ReadingReport.title: ReadingReport

part.description: 1 for the first lesson, 2 for its follow-ups, and so on.
part.title: Part

jobs.description: Today's other jobs that are queued, running, or failed, newest first.
jobs.title: Jobs

unfinished.description: Opened but unfinished lessons from the last 14 days, newest first, max 5.
unfinished.title: Unfinished

login_expires_at.description: When the worker's Claude login ends, if the CLI reported it.
login_expires_at.title: Login Expires At

online.description: A heartbeat arrived in the last 30 seconds.
online.title: Online

post.description: Queue today's daily lesson unless it exists or is already queued.
